programme.name: ScrollUniversity Foundation Core
programme.credit_system: ScrollUniversity workload units benchmarked to ECTS workload conventions
programme.credit_disclaimer: These workload units use the ECTS workload convention only as a planning benchmark. ScrollUniversity does not award ECTS or transferable academic credit.
programme.purpose: A common foundation that develops the academic, digital, quantitative, AI, communication and innovation capabilities required for successful higher education study.
programme_outcomes: Conduct ethical, evidence-based academic inquiry and distinguish reliable evidence from unsupported claims.
Communicate reasoned arguments clearly in academic, professional and digital formats.
Interpret quantitative information and data with appropriate uncertainty and statistical caution.
Use digital systems safely, responsibly and effectively for learning and collaboration.
Use and evaluate AI systems with human oversight, critical judgement and responsible risk management.
Identify opportunities, test assumptions and translate ideas into ethically and economically reasoned action.
